tieu_de: Remote - Backend Lead ExpressJS, NodeJS, Postgres
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
1. Backend Architecture & System Design
Lead the design and architecture of scalable and reliable backend systems
Make key technical decisions covering system architecture, APIs, databases, and integrations
Design solutions that support scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability
Contribute to architectural standards and technical direction across backend systems
2. Backend Development & Code Quality
Develop, review, and optimize high-quality backend code
Build and maintain robust backend services using Node.js and Express.js
Conduct code reviews and establish development standards and best practices
Improve code quality, maintainability, and overall engineering efficiency
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues
3. Performance, Scalability & Security
Monitor and optimize backend performance, scalability, and reliability
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and technical limitations
Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, and data protection practices
Ensure backend services are designed to handle increasing traffic and business requirements
Proactively identify and address technical risks and vulnerabilities
4. Technical Leadership & Mentorship
Guide and mentor backend engineers through technical challenges and development practices
Set engineering standards and promote high-quality development practices
Support engineers in improving their technical capabilities and problem-solving skills
Encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the team
5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and dependencies clearly
Drive continuous improvement across backend development processes and systems
Manage technical debt and identify opportunities for technology and process improvements
